FR-001.title: A person raising a request MUST choose a Category, and then an Item, in that order.

FR-002.title: The Item step MUST offer the Items the requesting job supports plus the job-independent Items and MUST never be empty; unsupported Items MUST NOT appear at all, because the check runs before the choice.

FR-003.title: No screen may offer a request type or a subtype, and the wizard type and subtype steps MUST be gone.

FR-004.title: A stored request MUST carry the chosen Category and Item, and MUST NOT carry a request type or a subtype.

FR-005.title: Every request renders as one card whose first line is the Item umbrella phrase and whose second line is the Item identifier.

FR-006.title: The card MUST use one layout for every Item; no layout variant may be selected by Item.

FR-007.title: An Item own fields MUST appear on the request page and MUST NOT appear on the card.

FR-008.title: The card MUST keep the four metadata rows: who asked, the work centre, the time remaining, and how long it has waited.

FR-009.title: A card picture MUST be the Item picture, falling back to the Category picture only when the Item has none; a placeholder MUST NOT replace a resolved picture.

FR-010.title: The list MUST default to most-urgent-first.

FR-011.title: A viewer MUST be able to change the sort from a control beside the existing shell controls, and the choice MUST be remembered.

FR-012.title: Overdue requests MUST remain visibly marked as overdue whatever the sort.

FR-013.title: An Item behaviour MUST come from stored configuration rather than from compiled-in code.

FR-014.title: Every Item MUST have a configuration row, and an Item with no row MUST be reported as unavailable rather than half-configured.

FR-015.title: An Item configuration MUST be changeable without a code change and without a rebuild.

FR-016.title: A request deadline MUST be derived from its Item allotted minutes, never from a type or subtype.

FR-017.title: An Item with no configured minutes MUST use a 15-minute default, labelled as a default.

FR-018.title: The minutes screen MUST show, per Item, its configured minutes and the average its completed requests actually took, as visibly distinct values.

FR-019.title: The average MUST count only completed requests from acceptance to completion, a released-then-completed request contributing exactly once.

FR-020.title: Both configuration screens MUST reuse the role gate that already governs them and MUST NOT introduce a new one.

FR-021.title: An Item picture MUST be configurable per Item, and a nothing-configured answer MUST NOT replace a resolved image.

FR-022.title: Every user-visible string introduced or changed MUST come from the existing resource mechanism.

FR-023.title: The request type and subtype vocabulary, its catalogs, seed, read procedure and the services named for it MUST be removed, and the schema master lists kept in sync.

FR-024.title: Every data operation MUST go through a stored procedure; no inline statement text may be introduced.

FR-025.title: Every schema artifact added, changed or removed MUST ship with its matching rollback, and the master lists kept in sync.

FR-026.title: An unavailable Item, a refused action or a failed read MUST be reported in plain actionable language; nothing may fail silently.

FR-027.title: The per-Item field definitions MUST come solely from the request-configuration spreadsheet, and the application MUST NOT read, embed or ship it.

FR-028.title: The four Items whose value source does not exist yet MUST NOT be offered until that work lands.

FR-029.title: The wrong-material Items MUST each read as a single Deliver request whose second line carries the correct material identifier.

FR-030.title: The Scrap Item value MUST be the scrap type already set on the job; the user MUST NOT be asked to enter it.

FR-031.title: The Scrap Item MUST be offered only when the job has a real scrap decision, not No Scrap and not the Scrap Type Required placeholder.

FR-032.title: Choosing an Item MUST NOT change the request lifecycle: statuses, transitions and who may perform them stay exactly as they are.

approach: Re-key the half-built Category/Item layer onto the store rather than rebuild it: add one configuration table row per Item holding behaviour and allotted minutes, re-key the request row and its three procedures to category + item, collapse the seven per-type cards into the one WaitlistLineCardView with no Item-based layout variant, and re-key both Settings screens and the image scope from subtype to Item.
